correctness.rationale: The trace/determinant rank-one identity and signed-extreme Rayleigh optimization yield the exact divergence minimizer. Orthogonal-complement Rayleigh witnesses establish the global (not merely diagonal) spectral-condition infimum. Strict score monotonicity establishes the unique root, interval, boundary behavior, and exponential fixed-M sharp supremum. The packaged verify.py independently checks exact rational identities and finite samples; those samples are not used as universal proof.

Kaporin-condition equivalence does not imply spectral condition-number equivalence.

value.rationale: A complete phase diagram and exponential worst-case approximation ratio answer a natural preconditioner-design question: how much spectral conditioning is sacrificed by minimizing the directed logdet divergence under the same rank constraint? The difference is structural, applies globally to all signed Hermitian rank-one choices, and sharply bounds a relevant surrogate criterion without inferring solver runtime.
